rows.title: PoC integration: adopted every-2nd window grid + 4s early exit + EG2 2fps + 26-feature pixel logistic (descriptive verdicts)
rows.summary: n=150 human gold IndEgo windows, LOCO, clip-bootstrap 95% CI. Fused 4s: AUROC 0.874 [0.742,0.942], balanced acc 0.740; EG2 2fps 4s 0.860 [0.715,0.944]; pixel26 4s 0.797 [0.658,0.860]. Full-window comparison: fused 0.849 [0.721,0.929], EG2 0.842, pixel 0.804 (4s not worse; CIs overlap, difference not established). Verdicts over 150 windows: accept 108 / reject 27 / uncertain 15. Every-2nd grid samples 77/150 windows (51.3%). Clip verdicts (sampled bad fraction >= 0.30): 5/7 agree with label-oracle truth (misses desk 0.20 vs 0.45 and pallet2 0.00 vs 0.67, n_sampled=3); E3.01's 7/7 is label-oracle, this is model-based. Cost per E3.04: every-2 x1.94; every-2 + 4s exit x4.86 (~0.907h per 4.404h corpus, 0.2059 of footage). OOD 60 windows (51 good/9 bad) included DESCRIPTIVE ONLY from frozen full-window scores (accept 17 / reject 29 / uncertain 14); no cached features exist to re-score them at 4s and NO OOD/accuracy claim is made.

rows.title: Label persistence and position bias on IndEgo gold
rows.summary: Neighbour agreement 0.73 vs 0.56 chance (n=143 pairs, ~15 s apart): sparse sampling plausible. Bad rate in first 120 s = 0.19 vs 0.42 later: skipping the start is NOT supported on IndEgo (the start is the cleaner part); must be tested per data type.

rows.title: Mosaic embedding (adopt candidate)
rows.summary: IndEgo LOCO (n=150, 7 clips) mosaic AUROC 0.757-0.842 over N=4..100, always below matched mean-of-frames (0.822-0.860); deltas -0.001..-0.214 (only N30 within 0.02 but OOD 0.155). rows.title: Mean-of-frames control (matched frames)
rows.summary: mean-of-frames control on the SAME decoded frames: IndEgo LOCO 0.822-0.860 over N=4..100 (N9 0.852 [0.75,0.91]; N16 0.860 [0.76,0.92]) reproduces the cached EG2 window-embedding reference 0.848 [0.73,0.91]. rows.title: Shuffled tile order
rows.summary: shuffled tile placement IndEgo 0.801 [0.64,0.89] vs ordered mosaic N9 0.785 [0.64,0.86]: delta +0.016, inside the CI; OOD 0.423. Tile order does not carry load-bearing signal -> no reason to shuffle.

rows.title: Mosaic without timestamps
rows.summary: no-timestamp mosaic IndEgo 0.810 [0.68,0.88] vs with-timestamps 0.785: delta +0.025 inside CI; OOD 0.444. Burned-in timestamps do not add signal beyond pixels.

rows.title: Single middle frame
rows.summary: single middle frame (1x1, t=5s) IndEgo 0.784 [0.69,0.85] ~= mosaic N9 0.785 [0.64,0.86] (1/9 the embedding cost) but 0.068 below mean-of-frames N9 0.852; OOD 0.514. Cheapest input but below the 0.02 bar to the baseline.

rows.title: Motion mosaic (|I_t - I_{t-1}| tiles)
rows.summary: motion mosaic |I_t-I_{t-1}| N=9 IndEgo 0.863 [0.78,0.91] is the best in-domain variant (mean-of-frames N9 0.852) but OOD 0.401 (fails transfer, like all IndEgo-trained models). Motion/stability cue again looks inverted/regime-specific; part may be head stability, not hand work.

rows.title: Pooled per-tile statistics control (no layout)
rows.summary: pooled per-tile stats concat(mean,std) of N=9 tile embeddings IndEgo 0.826 [0.69,0.88], OOD 0.586. Control confirms layout/timestamp are not load-bearing and it does not beat mean-of-frames 0.852.

rows.title: Sparse probe vs full coverage on IndEgo clips (label oracle + OOF scores)

rows.summary: 4.404h corpus: every-2 -> 2.27h (x1.9); every-2 + 4s exit -> ~0.9h (x4.9); every-3 + 4s -> x7.2 (decode-bound upper bound).

rows.title: Sampling-policy decision rule per data regime
rows.summary: Adopted IndEgo: every-2nd + 4s exit (~0.20 footage, x5). Dropped: CUSUM-sampler, skip-first-M, random grids. OOD: no certified policy (transfer fails; n_bad=9). Sampling not the bottleneck (model err 0.167 full coverage). Thin: 7 clips, sparse gold, IndEgo-only exit curve.

rows.title: Independent verification of pod baselines, E1.01-E1.02 fps sweeps and E3.01-E3.05 temporal policy
rows.summary: 20/20 core claims reproduced EXACTLY from pod/base: pixel26 0.810, EG2 0.8480 [0.734,0.909], prob-avg 0.853, rank-avg 0.856; E1.01 10/5/3.33/2/1 fps 0.8086/0.7932/0.8068/0.7866/0.7736; E1.02 2/1/0.5 fps 0.8480/0.8596/0.8702 (plus an independent from-scratch re-implementation with identical point estimates); two-view 0.8524/0.8538; E3.01 every-2 clip-error 0.0486 [0.0189,0.0872], 7/7 verdicts, delay 0.286 at 0.515 of windows; E3.02 MW p=0.419/0.468 (n=60, n_bad=9); E3.03 2/4/6/8/10.5 s = 0.8038/0.8596/0.8694/0.8574/0.8480; E3.04 x1.94; E3.05 strict-pass ['every-2']. TWO FINDINGS FAILED VERIFICATION: (1) 14/316 SHA256SUMS.txt entries mismatch on disk, including the frozen scorer caches/ensemble/ensemble_v1.json (recorded 4da1068a..., on disk cf7fd7d3...) and labels/manifest_gold.json - cause is post-checksum path remapping (the file contains the pod path /workspace/jadal_pod_bundle/data/eg2); no canonical-JSON variant matches either; LB4 recovered the byte-exact frozen file from git blob 0ede3b83d93ce23dc5b68cd20fb7de0af703ad27. (2) OOD ATTRIBUTION FIXED: the published 0.529 is the PoC CASCADE and reproduces exactly (origin/main:eval/results/poc/ood_check_60.json -> 0.529 [0.316,0.728], 21/51 good rejected, 5/9 bad, bal.acc 0.513 vs published 0.51); the FROZEN ensemble_v1 is a different figure, 0.415 [0.207,0.630] with 26/51 good rejected and 3/9 bad (p_eg2 0.586, p_pixel 0.342). My first pass conflated the two scorers. No drift involved (shipped OOD file is byte-identical to origin/main, sha256 300c1eda...). Both scorers are at chance with heavy false rejects, so the finding the submission rests on is confirmed twice. 29 attempts recorded by verifier PR #100. Also: the frozen artifact hash IS recoverable and verifies (git blob 0ede3b83d93ce23dc5b68cd20fb7de0af703ad27 -> sha256 4da1068a..., independently re-checked by LB1). ADDITIONAL LIVE HAZARD: jadal.ensemble.scorer.load_config() raises ValueError on the DEFAULT config path (config sha256 mismatch d62a95a4... != recorded 4da1068a...) on pod/base and every branch tested, because the shipped config is the path-remapped file while the .sha256 still records the frozen hash; meanwhile the LB2 PoC loader (jadal/poc_stream/policy.py load_frozen_ensemble) does NOT check the sha256 at all and loads the remapped artifact silently. Strict loader fails on a recoverable situation, lenient loader succeeds on the wrong artifact. Fix: point the default path at the recovered hash-verified configs/frozen/ensemble_v1.prereg.json (LB4, PR #97) and make the PoC loader fail closed. LB2 C-sensitivity independently verified (PR #98): fused 4s AUROC 0.8736 at C_eg2=0.003 vs 0.8734 at published C_eg2=0.01, paired delta -0.0002 CI [-0.0133,+0.0095] => C choice is immaterial; do not frame it as an improvement over 0.848 (that is a full-window inner-OOF number). POST-GPU-UNLOCK ADDITIONS (the GPU was never broken - see docs/reports/pod_verification.md §9: the driver was loaded and CUDA 12.8 installed, but the execution sandbox denied /dev/nvidia* with EACCES, which surfaced as NVML 'Unknown Error'; once device access was granted the A40 came up immediately). (a) FEATURE-EXTRACTION HALF NOW VERIFIED: all 150 gold windows re-derived from source video reproduce caches/gpu/features.json to max|delta| 7.11e-15 (mean per-window max 1.81e-15). (b) NESTED AUROCs RECOMPUTED FROM RAW PROBABILITIES (oof_probs.npz holds the NESTED OOF probs): EG2 0.8458, pixel 0.7916, prob-avg 0.8336, rank-avg 0.8440 - exactly the published nested figures, so the earlier caveat that they could not be recomputed from scratch is RETRACTED. (c) E1.02b (denser EG2 at 5/10 fps) and the EG2 embedding-cache reproduction are running as separate tracks. (d) RECEIPT + DETERMINISM CLAIMS VERIFIED: receipt hash is stable across calls and processes, the timestamp and receipt_id are excluded/derived correctly, tampering any of the 5 body fields is detected, key order is irrelevant (sorted-key canonical JSON), there is no signature field inside the receipt, and the CPU feature path gives an identical quantised digest over 10 repeated runs (max spread 0.0, cross-process match). (e) GPU KERNEL PARITY: the GPU feature kernels agree with the verified CPU reference on 22/26 features to <1e-6, but 7 features move >1e-3 on this device (rppg_pulse up to 0.57 abs, radial_slope 0.24, dup_hash_mean 0.14, illum_* ~0.008, pca_top1_share 0.003). Decision impact measured over all 150 windows: LOCO AUROC 0.7998 from GPU features vs 0.8100 from CPU features, paired clip-bootstrap delta -0.0093 [-0.0304,+0.0149] => the difference is NOT established at n=150. So the fast GPU path is usable without a demonstrated accuracy cost, but it is NOT the same artifact as the published 0.810 and any number must say which path produced it.

rows.title: Denser EG2 sampling (5/10 fps) vs the 2 fps IndEgo view
rows.summary: n=150 IndEgo human windows (100 good/50 bad, 7 clips, one labeller), device A40. EG2 LOCO AUROC: 2 fps published 0.8480 [0.733,0.910]; 2 fps same-pass control 0.8468 [0.733,0.909]; 5 fps 0.8486 [0.743,0.910]; 10 fps 0.8478 [0.739,0.910]. Paired clip-bootstrap deltas (B=2000, shared resamples) against the published 2 fps cache: 5 fps +0.0006 [-0.0051,+0.0140], 10 fps -0.0002 [-0.0082,+0.0127]; density-only vs the same-pass 2 fps control: 5 fps +0.0018 [-0.0045,+0.0151], 10 fps +0.0010 [-0.0073,+0.0127]; noise floor (same frames re-embedded) -0.0012 [-0.0048,+0.0049]. NO difference is established at any density and the point estimates sit at the noise floor, so denser sampling is dropped on cost-effectiveness: 2.5x (5 fps) and 5.0x (10 fps) the embedding work per window (0.85 s -> 2.12 s -> 4.23 s measured on the A40). Decode validated pixel-identical to the published seek decode (6/6 windows), per-frame cosine 0.9947.

rows.title: Z4.01

rows.title: Z2.01
rows.summary: Split-conformal decision sets give a monotone U-shaped review/error frontier under clip-grouped LOCO; empirical coverage tracks nominal. Min review 3.3% at coverage 0.80 (marginal FA 6%); coverage 0.85 gives review 12% with marginal FA 4%<=5% and stated marginal false-decision bound 15%.

rows.title: Z2.02
rows.summary: Marginal split-conformal coverage holds (0.80->0.800, 0.90->0.893) because ICC of the conformity score is ~0.02 despite raw-score ICC 0.46; but clip-conditional coverage fails (worst clip 0.647 at nominal 0.90). Mondrian-by-clip lifts clip-conditional coverage to 0.873; Mondrian-by-score-strata near-nominal; cluster-bootstrap over-corrects at K=7.

rows.title: Z2.03
rows.summary: With K=7 exchangeable clips a nonparametric cluster UCB cannot certify a 5% false-accept bound at 90% confidence (floor UCB 0.66; EB 1.0; LOCO-honest no fold). Window-Bentkus reaches 5% at 88.7% review but assumes window exchangeability, which intra-clip correlation violates. The guarantee is data-limited by the number of clips, not the tail bound.

rows.title: O2.03
rows.summary: 160-label table: 8 stable / 14 flip / 4 chance (same counts as the 60). Only 2/26 change class: frozen_frac flip->stable, global_shift stable->flip. Sharpness trio stable (radial_slope 0.633/0.635, hf_ratio 0.618/0.657, dct_energy 0.631/0.700 with grouped CI [0.55,0.83]); motion_energy still flips (0.308->0.646). Transferable subset (stable & >=0.10): dct_energy, hf_ratio, radial_slope, luma_p05, illum_b, illum_r, frozen_frac.

rows.title: MR.01
rows.summary: Tiles 112-160px at 3x3 match/better 224px (0.803-0.804 vs 0.785) at -36% ms/win and -74% canvas px; smallest within 0.02 of best = 112px. Still below mean-of-frames N9 0.851. Adopt small tiles for a mosaic pipeline.

rows.title: MR.02
rows.summary: At matched frame count mosaic loses to mean-of-frames at EVERY density (-0.048 N9, -0.063 N16, -0.113 N25, -0.081 N36). Best density 3x3 (0.803). E2 verdict stands; density does not recover the gap.

rows.title: MR.03
rows.summary: Equal canvas (~462-465k px): 16x168px (0.845) beats 9x224px (0.785) by +0.060 AUROC at -2.4 ms/win -> supports 'more smaller tiles, no loss'. But mosaic still within 0.016 of mean-of-frames N16 (0.861) and only ties EG2 baseline 0.848. Timestamps help +0.021; order irrelevant.

rows.title: Z3.01
rows.summary: 20 candidates: 9 stable / 11 flip. Stable: ct_fsize_std, ct_fsize_cv, inv_clip_frac, inv_laplacian_var, inv_hist_entropy, mo_hand_motion_excess, inv_dct_hf_lf, ct_iframe_frac, ct_fsize_entropy. Flips: absolute bitrate/frame-size, all raw motion residuals (translation AND full affine), noise_snr, dhash.

rows.title: Z3.02
rows.summary: Affine fix did NOT restore sign (mo_affine_resid 0.322/0.728 flips, same as translation-only 0.301/0.704). Absolute bitrate flips (0.376/0.802). Survivors: hand-region motion EXCESS (0.649/0.771), compression variability ct_fsize_std (0.620/0.747), invariants clip_frac/laplacian_var/hist_entropy.

rows.title: Z3.03
rows.summary: Raw-feature logistic zero-shot OOD 0.497 (stable8+6) - collapses. Per-domain z-score signed equal-weight: 6-transferable IndEgo 0.684 / OOD 0.852 [0.732,0.950]; stable8+6 IndEgo 0.736 / OOD 0.841 [0.712,0.942]. Frozen ensemble OOD 0.415. OOD few-shot (factory CV) 0.776.

rows.title: Frozen PoC out-of-domain evaluation on the 160 human labels
rows.summary: Frozen ensemble OOD AUROC 0.566 (window CI 0.433-0.693; factory-grouped 0.414-0.697), up from a noise-level 0.415 at n=60. Shipped operating point: accept 71 / review 35 / reject 54; BA 0.387 review=miss (0.546 scalar@0.5); it hard-rejects 47/138 good windows (34%) and rejects only 7/22 bad. Weak positive ranking signal, not separable from chance; unusable as a gate.

rows.title: RES.01
rows.summary: Encoded resolution can drop to 180p (0.8428, 198 KiB) and 120p (0.8022, 137 KiB) with no AUROC loss vs 0.810 native; no knee down to 120p; all rungs within 0.02 (one CI).

rows.title: RES.02
rows.summary: Target met: CRF28=0.7960 (dAUROC -0.014) at 57% of CRF23 bytes; CRF33=0.7946 (-0.015) at 36%; no CRF broke 0.02.

rows.title: RES.03
rows.summary: 360p@CRF28=0.8036 at 257 KiB (best bytes/accuracy, 40% of 480p@CRF23 bytes); 240p@CRF28=0.7934 at 169 KiB inside budget.

rows.title: RES.04
rows.summary: Pixel-26 OOD AUROC~0.43 (IndEgo head does not transfer) and is resolution-neutral: 480p d-0.002 [-0.026,+0.019], 360p d+0.013 [-0.034,+0.059]. EG2 view NOT recomputed.

rows.title: Y1.01
rows.summary: Raw symmetric band w=0.16 -> review 53.4% (from 75.5%) at IndEgo gold BA 0.846 (err 0.154, 95% CI 0.662-0.931); exact widest band <60% is w=0.177 (59.6%, err 0.150); w=0.12 gives 37.0% at err 0.153. Calibration does NOT cut review at equal error: in-sample temperature is neutral vs raw (31.6% vs 32.0% min review at gold err<=0.155); the LOCO temperature 'gain' (9.4%) is a per-fold small-sample artifact; Platt/isotonic degrade gold BA to 0.71/0.725. OOD-60 decisions stay 0.34-0.53 BA (near chance, n_bad=9) -> unreliable.

rows.title: Y2.01
rows.summary: Decision-theoretic gating: gating at coverage 45% (cost 1:1) cuts the 1,546-window REVIEW share 75.5%->55.0%; gold-LOCO BA 0.837 [0.645,0.937] (n=150); OOD-60 eval-only BA 0.496 (near chance, AUROC 0.415, n_bad=9); asymmetric costs 2:1/5:1 hurt (weighted err 0.309/0.382 vs 0.162).

rows.title: Y2.02
rows.summary: Deterministic stage-0 rules fire on 6/6 of each synthetic black/darken/overexpose/frozen and 0/6 clean/blur/noise/shake/lowbitrate/static; on 150 gold they fire 3x (precision_bad 0.67, n=3, matching the funnel's no-certified-rule result); on the 1,546 they fire 39x (2.5%) and drop review 55.0%->54.0%. Combined pipeline reaches 54.0% review. Calibration (gold-LOCO temperature) is a no-op on share and hurts gold BA -> dropped.

rows.title: Y3.02
rows.summary: NEGATIVE: adding cached views does not cut ambiguity at equal/better AUROC; every extra view raises the review-band mass and AUROC is flat/worse. EG2-alone dominates the two-view baseline (AUROC .834->.846, profile-band .653->.420). Rank-average is a free improvement (.653->.607). All AUROC diffs within CI.

rows.title: Y3.01
rows.summary: Baseline reproduced: fixed-C two-view prob-average AUROC 0.8534, nested-LOCO 0.8336. Per-view nested AUROC: eg2 0.8458, perpixel121 0.8140, pixel26 0.7916, series16 0.7912, physics16 0.7608, theory18 0.6698. EG2@1fps/@0.5fps caches absent (only @2fps).

rows.title: Honest review-vs-OOD-error frontier on the 160-window pre-registered OOD label set
rows.summary: Frozen score reproduced on 160/160 (accept 64/reject 54/review 42); OOD AUROC usable_prob 0.566 [0.422,0.702], p_eg2 0.589, p_pixel 0.520, rank-avg 0.563. Band w=0.16 -> review 53.4% OOD BA 0.577 [0.415,0.740]; w=0.17 -> 57.4% BA 0.600 [0.440,0.767]. Gate c=0.45 -> review 55.0% BA 0.629 [0.444,0.822] (1546-cutoff variant 0.587 [0.427,0.752]). Rank-avg lifts OOD BA to 0.690 at gate c=0.45 and 0.708 at band w=0.155-0.16 (review 42.8-44.2%) but AUROC is flat (0.563) -> operating-point effect.

rows.title: SKIP.01
rows.summary: drop1-start err 0.110 (worst, confirms E3) vs drop1-end 0.057 / drop1-evenly 0.033-0.041; drop2-start 0.189. START-drop biases high, END-drop low (bad rate sec1 0.09 -> sec5 0.58). END/MIDDLE/EVENLY keep 7/7 verdicts but every variant is dominated by uniform-every-2 (0.049 @ 51%). No section drop adopted.

rows.title: SKIP.02
rows.summary: strat-probe(1/section) err 0.142 @ 33.1% beats equal-budget contiguous probe 0.211 @ 33.1% and lifts agreement 0.57->0.86, but is not better than uniform-every-3 (0.117 @ 34.9%). dense-where-uncertain x1 0.100 @ 45.9% loses to uniform at equal budget (~0.072); x2 0.057 @ 62.5% also loses. Reproduces E3 CUSUM rejection.

rows.title: SKIP.03
rows.summary: Best cell = uniform-every-2: 51.5% processed, error 0.049 [0.019,0.087], 7/7 verdicts @0.30. Only policy meeting agreement>=0.90 AND error<=0.05; still wins when relaxing error to 0.07/0.10. No section-skip policy is cheaper within tolerance.

rows.title: O4.01
rows.summary: Z3 transferable-6 per-domain z-score: OOD-160 AUROC 0.759 [0.597,0.886] grouped, BA 0.709; stable-8+6 0.781 [0.634,0.895], BA 0.733; frozen 0.566. Paired grouped gain +0.19/+0.21 (99.5% >0). Gain holds at n_bad=22; q2 alone (0.70/0.73) not separable from chance.

rows.title: O4.02
rows.summary: All 6 Z3 transferable candidates stable on OOD-160; 9 stable/10 flip/1 chance across 20 candidates; selection set unchanged.
